description: A quarter's results press release set against the 10-Q or 10-K filed after it: every figure in the release's tables looked for among the report's inline XBRL facts for the same period. Lists the figures that changed (release value, filed value, difference, percent, the XBRL concept and how the line was matched), release figures with no counterpart (non-GAAP measures, metrics) and lines the report adds, such as a charge booked after the release.

max_rows.description: Most changed figures and release-only labels listed; default 40.

period.description: The quarter: its end date (2026-06-30; a few days off is fine for 52-53 week years) or a fiscal label (Q2 2026, FY2025: the fiscal year that ends in that year). Default: the latest quarter whose 10-Q or 10-K is filed.

name: release_check

outputSchema.description: changed is a table of the release's figures the report shows differently, values in the release's scale (difference is filed minus release, matched_by says how the line was found); release_only lists release lines with no counterpart in the report; filed_only lists report lines no release line matches.

title: Earnings release against the 10-Q or 10-K
